title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Credit Policy Note — Repeat Window for Revolving Late Fees
content:
The repeat window is the span, in whole calendar months counted back from the correction date, within which a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account's earlier late fees are looked at when its most recent late fee is re-rated. It is set by the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership and the account's age:

1. When the business holds an active ProBuild Silver, Gold, Platinum or Platinum Elite membership and the account has been open at least **60** whole months, the repeat window is the member window of **6** months.
2. When the account has been open at least **24** whole months and the first condition is not met, it is the standard window of **12** months.
3. In every other case it is the newer-account window of **24** months.

Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the correction date. The membership is the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status, read by its tier name; a ProBuild Member or Bronze membership, or no active membership, does not meet the first condition.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Membership | Account open | Repeat window |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Silver | 60 months | 6 months |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 59 months | 12 months |
| ProBuild Bronze | 80 months | 12 months |
| ProBuild Gold | 23 months | 24 months |
| No membership | 10 months | 24 months |
